Il faut une passerelle NMEA Wi-Fi (boîti: You need an NMEA Wi-Fi gateway (a box wired to the instruments, or a chartplotter with Wi-Fi) and a Signal K server. Some gateways include one; otherwise a small Raspberry Pi computer with OpenPlotter (free) does it.
Une appli web ne peut pas lire les flux: A web app cannot read raw NMEA streams (TCP or UDP, port 10110 or 2000 for example). Signal K receives these streams and republishes them in a form NavIn can read (WebSocket).

NavIn étant une appli sécurisée (https),: Since NavIn is a secure app (https), Safari and Chrome often block ws://. In Signal K, turn on SSL (port 3443); open https://ADDRESS:3443 once in the browser and accept the certificate; then enter wss://ADDRESS:3443/signalk/v1/stream?subscribe=all

Le plan incliné ou la voile. Hisser une: The ramp or the sail. Lifting a wet, limp 80 kg body over a high freeboard is impossible by arm strength alone. The net (or headsail) technique:

La voile s’enroule et fait remonter la v: The sail rolls up and lifts the victim along the hull as in a hammock, with no horizontal effort.
Allongez immédiatement la victime à l’ho: Lay the victim down flat immediately
Une fois la victime remontée, ne la forc: Once the victim is aboard, do not make them stand up. The sudden return of cold blood from the limbs to the heart (« afterdrop ») can cause cardiac arrest.

Joran (nord-ouest, depuis le Jura) : imp: Joran (north-west, from the Jura): unpredictable, with strong gusts from the start. It is often announced by big dark cumulus over the Jura and a quick drop in temperature.
Vaudaire (sud-est, Haut-Lac) : soudaine: Vaudaire (south-east, upper lake): sudden and violent, often linked to summer storms.
Vent (sud-ouest à ouest) : il annonce le: Vent (south-west to west): it heralds low-pressure systems.
Bornan (surtout entre Rolle et Lutry) et: Bornan (mainly between Rolle and Lutry) and môlan (Petit-Lac): sudden gusts coming down from the mountains, especially in hot weather.

⚓ Priorités et règles de route: ⚓ Right of way and steering rules
Tout bateau s’écarte, dans l’ordre : des: Every boat gives way, in this order: to priority boats (green ball by day, green light by night, e.g. the CGN), then cargo boats, then marked professional fishermen, then sailing boats. Motor boats also give way to rowing boats
Les bateaux en service régulier, comme l: Scheduled service boats, like the CGN, always have priority. Keep clear of their route and do not hinder their manoeuvres at the landing stages
Entre voiliers : celui qui reçoit le ven: Between sailing boats: the one on port tack gives way. If both are on the same tack, the windward boat gives way
Au moteur, le Savannah est un bateau à m: Under engine, Savannah is a motor boat. When routes cross, the one that sees the other on its starboard side gives way. Head-on, each passes port to port. The overtaking boat keeps clear
Distances : au moins 50 m des pêcheurs p: Distances: at least 50 m from marked professional fishermen and towed convoys, and 200 m when passing behind a fisherman. At least 50 m from a white and blue « A » diving flag
Un bateau qui balance un pavillon ou un: A boat swinging a red flag or light cannot manoeuvre: keep clear of it
Au port, le bateau qui sort est priorita: In harbour, the boat leaving has priority over the boat entering
La zone riveraine intérieure va jusqu’à: The inner shore zone goes up to 150 m from the shore. The outer zone goes from 150 to 300 m, measured from the shore, reed beds or structures in the water.
Au moteur : 10 km/h au maximum à moins d: Under engine: 10 km/h maximum within 300 m of the shore. Within 150 m, go only to berth, leave or moor, by the shortest route
Il est interdit d’entrer dans les roseau: Entering reeds, rushes and water lilies is forbidden. Generally keep 25 m away
Les bouées jaunes délimitent des zones i: Yellow buoys mark areas closed to navigation (swimming, reserves).
La baignade est interdite à moins de 100: Swimming is forbidden within 100 m of a harbour entrance or a CGN landing stage
Mouiller ou s’amarrer sans gêner la navi: Anchor or moor without hindering navigation, never in aquatic vegetation (25 m) nor near marked fishing nets
Hors des places autorisées, on ne laisse: Outside authorised places, a boat must not be left unattended for more than 24 h
Côté français : pas de nuit au mouillage: French side: no overnight anchoring, no anchoring on seagrass beds, and buoys are reserved for their holders
De nuit, un bateau au mouillage hors d’u: At night, a boat at anchor outside an authorised place shows an all-round white light
De nuit, à la voile seule : feux de côté: At night, under sail only: sidelights and sternlight, or a tricolour at the masthead. Under engine: motor boat lights, i.e. white masthead light, sidelights and sternlight
1 son bref : je viens sur tribord. 2 son: 1 short blast: I am turning to starboard. 2 short blasts: I am turning to port. 3 short blasts: I am going astern. 4 short blasts: I cannot manoeuvre
Une série de sons très brefs signale un: A series of very short blasts signals imminent danger of collision
Détresse : agiter un pavillon rouge en c: Distress: wave a red flag in a circle, fire red flares, make repeated long blasts or SOS (· · · – – – · · ·) by light, or slowly raise and lower outstretched arms
Porter secours aux personnes en danger s: Help people in danger if this does not endanger your own boat
S’il y a des blessés, des morts ou des d: If anyone is injured, dead or missing, alert the police at once: 117 in Switzerland, 112 everywhere. For an ambulance, 144. For a helicopter, Rega 1414.
En cas de dégâts matériels, prévenir le: In case of material damage, inform the injured party as soon as possible and remain available for the report
Savannah : noter l’incident dans la fich: Savannah: note the incident in the day sheet. For the CHF 500 excess, see Boat and cruise › Rules.
La frontière passe au milieu du lac. Tou: The border runs through the middle of the lake. All passengers must carry valid identity papers, even without stopping
Retour en Suisse : les achats sous la fr: Back in Switzerland: purchases under the CHF 150 allowance, or declared with the QuickZoll app, pass without formalities. Otherwise, stop at a customs landing stage: Lausanne-Ouchy, Geneva or Hermance
Moule quagga : nettoyer et rincer la coq: Quagga mussel: clean and rinse the hull and gear before going to another lake.
Un bateau qui demande un permis ne se lo: A boat that requires a licence may only be rented to someone who shows that licence
Le loueur signale les endroits dangereux: The charterer points out dangerous spots, local features and important rules
Sources : Ordonnance sur la navigation i: Sources: Swiss inland navigation ordinance (SR 747.201.1, as of 18.02.2020); Lake Geneva navigation regulation; Haute-Savoie prefecture, press kit « Lac Léman »; SISL, « Le Léman »; FOCBS, « Entering Switzerland by boat ».
Exigés à bord de tout bateau autorisé à: Required on board any boat allowed to go more than 300 m from the shore. Beyond 3.7 km from the shore, a Lake Geneva navigation chart is also needed (paper, or electronic on a GPS for example).
Les deux sont valables sur tout le Léman: Both are valid on the whole lake, Swiss side included. A copy is accepted by the Évian water police.
